arm_descriptions.A_tied_ce: candidate-conditioned nodes, tied two-layer graph weights
arm_descriptions.B_private_ce: candidate-conditioned nodes, 21 global-ID-private two-layer graph banks

identity.rule: A locked VAL: chosen percentage <= 0.1 and native winner count > 0

evidence_boundary: R110 refines each candidate node graph through two layers on shared original H4 before pooling. A_tied_ce ties these weights; B_private_ce has 21 banks keyed by global method ID, never candidate column, winner or outcome. Both retain candidate conditioning, original two joint layers and score MLP/maximin. TRAIN optimizes one-forward unweighted legal-pool raw-utility CE, weight 1; comparison, relative-risk and RDrop/KL weights are zero. Evaluation maximin CE is diagnostic, not the optimized raw-utility CE. A has 2,305,033 trainables; B has 10,220,553. The original 1,842,953-parameter base is fresh matched, and all late branches start from identical original-layer prototypes. The initial eval function is identical, but complete state hashes/dimensions are not identical. This is not parameter/FLOP-matched, a routing experiment, or an isolated capacity-only control. Original R88B physical TSP node0 role, methodID+34 and geometry/distance remain; 57,600 updates, logical batch1024, seed2. No new route/path fields, labels, donor, teacher, context, targets, calibration, quotas or auxiliary loss. R89A AdamW, R89B Muon and R84A are saved historical references, not rerun or newly parameter/FLOP-matched controls; R94B, R93A and R109 arms are explicit optional saved references, never implicit dependencies. NSS uses saved historical R79 weights, not retrained on new90k. Fixed36 true rescues/losses, false picks and aligned population net costs/regret are separate from selection frequency. Native/FP64 ind and legal pools; TRAIN-fitted SBS; ALL task-equal. TEST is development-exposed; one whole-model full18 VAL checkpoint per arm for full TRAIN/VAL/TEST/LIB; no TEST/LIB reselection. Actual standalone GPU-resident-input timing includes complete method-conditioned node refinement, excludes dataset I/O, CPU transfer and solvers, and is not end-to-end dataset latency. Microcaps/eval batch come from the main-witness locked runner, not this reporter. No routing summary is required. No online W&B equality/availability is asserted.

ce_diagnostics.training: one-forward unweighted legal-pool raw-utility CE, weight 1
ce_diagnostics.evaluation: original maximin CE diagnostic, not the training raw-utility CE objective

A_tied_ce.rule: strict minimum whole18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct; first exact tie; common full-TRAIN SBS

A_tied_ce.winner_rule: native int64 ind from locked source cache, verified against original FP64 argmin; never FP32 argmin
